about: The versionCode a launcher release tag was built with, as the launcher (SelfUpdatePlanTest, launcherTagVersionCode) and the server (install_now::launcher_tag_version_code) read it, and as scripts/release-version.sh builds it (its --selftest reads the launcher-v rows without '@'). Today's rule, from launcher-v0.36.0-rc.4 on: X*10_000_000 + Y*10_000 + Z*10 + N, N = the RC number 1..8, 9 for the release; X <= 199, Y and Z <= 999. Tags below it were built under the old rule, X*1_000_000 + Y*1_000 + Z, an RC one less, and read so. The part from '@' on (the server's release id) is ignored. code null = not a launcher release tag. Two byte-identical copies: server/testdata/launcher_tag_codes.json and launcher/app/src/test/resources/launcher_tag_codes.json; each suite fails if the other copy is missing or differs. Change both together.
